title: On the construction of almost periodic solutions for the derivative nonlinear Schrödinger equation
summary: In this paper, we consider a derivative nonlinear Schrödinger equation $$ \mathrm{i}\partial_{t}u+\partial_{xx}u-V\ast u+\mathrm{i}\vert u\vert^{2}\partial_{x}u=0 $$ on the torus $\mathbb{T}$, depending on some potential $V$. We prove that for `almost all' potentials $V$, this equation admits an almost-periodic solution.
